prompt: A robot factory: assemble the robot by bringing its head, body and legs to the workbench

intent.setting: Indoor robot factory floor with a central assembly workbench surrounded by storage racks holding head, body, and leg modules
intent.goal: Bring the robot's head, body, and legs from the racks to the workbench and place them in the correct order to complete the assembly
intent.fail: Assembling the robot in the wrong order, placing a part on the wrong mount, or failing to deliver all three core modules puts the unit together incorrectly and the shift ends in a defect.
intent.headline: Assembly sequence must follow head body legs on the workbench
